crossRefs.note: Boaz took ten men of the elders of the city, and said, “Sit down here,” and they sat down.
Moreover, Ruth the Moabitess, the wife of Mahlon, I have purchased to be my wife, to raise up the name of the dead on…
All the people who were in the gate, and the elders, said, “We are witnesses. May Yahweh make the woman who has come…
This is the third time I am coming to you. “At the mouth of two or three witnesses shall every word be established.”
King Ahaz went to Damascus to meet Tiglath Pileser king of Assyria, and saw the altar that was at Damascus; and king…
Urijah the priest built an altar. According to all that king Ahaz had sent from Damascus, so Urijah the priest made it…
He was twenty-five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned twenty-nine years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name…
